description: React component for an address modal with Google Maps integration, location autocomplete, and address submission functionality.

classes.name: AddressModal
classes.description: React functional component for address input and map interaction modal.

methods.name: AddressModal
methods.description: Main React component function handling address modal logic, state, and UI.

methods.name: handleLocationSelection
methods.description: Handles selection of location from autocomplete, fetches geocode data, and updates map region.

methods.name: changeCoordinates
methods.description: Updates map region and address based on marker drag end or map interaction.

methods.name: submitAddress
methods.description: Submits the selected address and coordinates.

methods.name: locationCallback
methods.description: Handles callback from geolocation fetch, updates map and address state.
